scope: Issuer SEC Form 10-Q nine-month cash-flow and management-commentary observations (unaudited). These are explanatory context, NOT additive EBITDA, standalone acquired-business FCFE or a normalized earnings forecast.

operatingWorkingCapitalMovement.scope: Reported consolidated changes in working capital; cash-flow reconciliation line. Not a proven recurring reversal.

acquisitionCashPaid.scope: Business acquisitions net of cash acquired; INVESTING cash flow, not a deduction from operating cash flow or capex in the reported FCF proxy.

financingBorrowingsProceeds.scope: Proceeds from borrowings; FINANCING cash flow and not an addition to company operating earnings.

financingShortTermDebtNet.scope: Short-term debt net cash financing; not to add to FCF.

expected2026PpeCapex.scope: Issuer approximate full-year FY2026 property, plant, equipment capital expenditures; management expectation not realized cash flow.

IE00B8KQN827.acquisitionTransactionNotes: Boyd Thermal completed March 2026; acquisition accounting and debt financing change comparability. An acquired-business full-year pro-forma operating cash flow and post-deal cash-interest run rate are not independently available from these fields.

operatingWorkingCapitalMovement.scope: Management discussion of TRADE working capital, not total group working capital; not directly comparable to Eaton's reported total.

acquisitionCashPaid.scope: Business acquisitions net of cash acquired; INVESTING cash flow, not operating cash flow.

softwareCapitalized.scope: Cash investments in capitalized software are separate from property, plant, equipment CapEx. Disclosure supports a distinct optional broader reinvestment indicator, not an automatic rewrite of reported OCF-minus-PPE-CapEx.
